name: smwmusic-shin-megami-tensei-if-epilogue
title: Shin Megami Tensei if... - Epilogue
description:
Plays after you beat the game.
I made 2 different version. The original that doesn‘t loop and a modified version that loops.
You can switch between the versions with:
set define to #define Looping 0, to get the non-looping version (original)
set define to #define Looping 1, to get the looping version
